_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy to deploy.config.json (gitignored) and fill in. Project paths are relative to the repo root. Plugin name = project file name without extension; DependsOn lists DIRECT dependencies by that name, or "Host". Derived from ProjectReferences. ShutdownUrls (optional) maps a target name to its full shutdown URL; the admin password is sent in cleartext over http, so only use http on the trusted intranet behind the nginx /admin/ gate (prefer https). Unsure whether PhigrosApi, PersonalWebsite and MinimalDependency are deployed as plugins; PhigrosLoginHost, SaveArchiveProgram and run helpers are left out.
